metadata.case_name: FONG KIT MAN v. NG TSZ KEUNG W P CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: unlikely to be able to return to his pre-injury job since he is mainly wheelchair bound although he can walk a few steps with a quadripod; unlikely also to be able to engage in any gainful employment

source: the injury to his back resulted in a prolapsed intervertebral disc at L5/S1
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (“MRI") carried out in July 2004 showed that the plaintiff’s L5/S1 disc herniation increased in size slightly when compared with the MRI done in July 2003.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: chronic left L5 and S1 radiculopathy
injuries.body_part: left L5 and S1 nerve roots / left lower limb
source: Electromyography and nerve conduction study was carried out on 24 October 2003 in Tuen Mun Hospital which confirmed chronic left L5 and S1 radiculopathy.
As a result of the 2nd Accident, Dr Yong diagnosed the plaintiff to be suffering acute exacerbation of left lower limb radiculopathy resulting from a prolapsed intervertebral disc.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of nerves at abdomen, lower back or pelvis level

source: the plaintiff complained of erectile dysfunction and was referred to urology for assessment and follow up.
the complaint by the plaintiff of erectile dysfunction was genuine which was of acute onset right after the 2nd Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to male genital organ without specification of injury type

source: since early 2004, the plaintiff has been receiving psychological treatment (both as outpatient as well as inpatient) and medication from the Castle Peak Hospital in relation to his psychiatric problems and was diagnosed by doctors of Castle Peak Hospital to be suffering from Major Depressive Disorder.

manifestations.description: nausea and severe low back pain
stiff and tender back; left leg weak and sensation impaired; ankle jerks were absent
neuralgia which limited his mobility and also affected his wellbeing
depressed mood, poor temper control and insomnia
wheelchair bound; can walk a few steps with a quadripod

treatments_received: posterior diskectomy of L5/S1 (operation of posterior diskectomy on 2 November 2004)
admission for pain management and physiotherapy
psychological treatment (outpatient and inpatient) and medication from Castle Peak Hospital
treatments_future: psychiatric treatment in the public sector for two years (monthly sessions)
Viagra medication (urological treatment) assessed using a multiplier of 4

losses.description: limited his mobility; effectively wheelchair bound and can only take a few steps with the assistance of a quadripod
impairment from a prolapsed intervertebral disc at L5/S1

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: erectile dysfunction sparked off by the back injury
depressive symptoms with impaired concentration and memory affecting wellbeing

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: limitations to activities of daily living caused by neuralgia and reduced mobility
